en_US: Well, now that we’ve made each other’s
acquaintance, shall we trade phone
numbers? {YESNO 0}
Lovely!
Now I shall be able to call you anytime.
I see...
As to be expected, children prefer to
spend time with others their own age...
You don’t really want to trade
phone numbers with me, do you? {YESNO 0}
What’s wrong? Aren’t we on the same
floor right now?
Why not talk in person?
I was so surprised!
A few days ago, I received a NOCTOWL
when I traded with someone.
It turns out that NOCTOWL was the same
one I gave away in a trade with another
Trainer years ago!
I guess that’s a case of “What goes
around, comes around,” in that it came
back to me.
The world is small after all!
It’s kind of disappointing.
A few days ago, I received a NOCTOWL
when I traded with someone.
It was such a familiar NOCTOWL...
I thought it was the NOCTOWL that I had
originally trained!
It’d somehow found its way back...
I was so moved...
But when I looked closer, I saw that
it wasn’t the NOCTOWL I thought it was.
That kind of thing can’t really happen
in this world, right?
You know, whenever I try to catch a
wild Pokémon, they seem to always run
away. It’s happened so many times.
A couple days ago a RATTATA got away
from me...
You know, whenever I meet a person or
Pokémon, I always make sure to take off
my hat and introduce myself properly,
and that’s when they run away.
RATTATA are such impolite creatures...
Ha ha, would you like to battle again?
I think that’s a fine idea!
I’ll meet you at {STRVAR_1 4, 3, 0}!
Is everything all right?
Did you forget about our appointment?
I’m waiting at {STRVAR_1 4, 3, 0}.
I will see you there!
Just like this, when calling a young
person such as yourself, you can trade
information.
Just like this, Pokémon bring people
together, don’t they?
Truly, Pokémon are such
extraordinary creatures.
